newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks mixed at close after volatile session.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks mixed at close after volatile session.

text.p: Madrid stocks ended mixed on Monday after a volatile session spent searching for direction following a long weekend. Dealers said trade had focused on a handful of blue-chip stocks.

General index ended marginally higher, up 3.78 points, 0.63 percent, to 600.04, while the Ibex-35 index of leading shares closed lower, down 13.07 points, 0.19 percent, to 6,817.69. Turnover reached 83.42 billion pesetas.
"Business has been dominated by traders with very rapid movements in positions and the general tone is one of uneasiness in the light of strong falls that we have seen recently," one dealer said.
Trade centred on Repsol, Telefonica, Iberdrola, Endesa and the large banks, dealers said.
Telefonica rose 65 pesetas to 4,165, in what analysts said was a technical rebound. Endesa rose 50 pesetas to 3,200.
Repsol slipped 60 pesetas to 6,250 after JP Morgan downgraded its recommendation on the stock to "market performer". Iberdrola lost 10 pesetas to 1,690.
Argentaria, which announced a 10.7 percent fall in its net attributable income for the first half, fell 50 pesetas to 8,800.
